Home / Government

Who holds office, and what is published.

The municipal site publishes the current elected officials, twenty departments and offices, a vision and mission page, and awards notices. This page indexes those records without turning them into a claim of completeness.

Where another government source disagrees with the municipal site, both are named and the conflict is left visible.

On this page Elected officialsDepartments and officesPlans and awardsA conflicting record

Conflicting mayor record

The municipal Elected Officials page lists Hon. Jane A. Casas as mayor. The DTI CMCI profile lists Hon. Edralyn Joy A. Salvame as mayor for 2024 and earlier years. This guide follows the municipal page for the roles shown above and treats the CMCI field as stale.
